subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: Should OpenClaw core accept native backup exclude-pattern controls now, and if so what default/protected-path semantics should the implementation require?
rationale: This adds new CLI surface to a recovery/security path and can change backup completeness, so automation should not choose defaults or protected-path policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor guarded native exclude support
options.body: Approve a native implementation only after protected paths, sensitive-file handling, docs, and real backup/restore proof are reviewed.

options.title: Keep this external for now
options.body: Defer native flags and point users to ClawHub backup packages until core backup design is revisited.

options.title: Narrow to bloat bugs first
options.body: Reject general user patterns for now and only hard-code narrowly proven rebuildable or volatile paths in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor guarded native exclude support
recommendation.body: Approve a native implementation only after protected paths, sensitive-file handling, docs, and real backup/restore proof are reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged recent backup hardening and are the best available owner for a backup security/product boundary choice from the observed history.
